pages.title: Antimatter Singularity
pages.text: Antimatter compressed into a single point without touching any matter, which ought to be impossible. It holds an almost unimaginable amount of energy. It glows faintly and must never be dropped. It is kept in a magnetic cradle and checked on more often than strictly necessary.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Antimatter annihilates on contact, so compressing it took careful magnetic fields. The Singularity Compactor eventually crushed the pellets into one point without letting them touch anything.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Exotic Chemistry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
